# Memmy v1.2.2

## Highlights

- Improved memory initialization and turn capture by moving bounded work off the model path and exposing clearer background-capture diagnostics.
- Improved bundled Memory runtime upgrades by selecting runtimes by build identity and validating the installed runtime across macOS and Windows.
- Added long-document reading with bounded chunks and continuation offsets for PDF and Office files.
- Improved agent-source ingestion, auto-injection, and skill distribution with broader regression coverage and clearer lifecycle handling.
- Fixed LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible JSON response-format incompatibilities by retrying with text mode when needed.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Refreshed installed Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor hooks when their bundled revision or on-disk files are stale, and record the revision only after a successful install.
- Kept queued memory processing moving after session close and retained end-topic turns that contain feedback or instructions for L1 capture.
- Improved filesystem and document tools with consistent line numbering, continued long-document reads, and expanded agent-runtime regression coverage.
- Tightened analytics boundaries by avoiding raw search queries, memory text, and identifiers in CLI command actions while reporting stored-memory and source-layer events consistently.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent are version `1.2.2`.
- The bundled Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned.
- Memory protocol version remains `1`.
